$oracle-run.description: The end-to-end Oracle flow: merge-base, absorb base/A/B, diff each side, synthesize justifications, predict the merge from meaning, run git's real merge read-only, score the confusion matrix, append the OracleRecord.

steps.action: Resolve merge-base(A, B)
Lift base, A, B to WarpStates (detached temp worktrees)
diff(base, A) and diff(base, B)
Synthesize justA / justB from git log + ripple
predict(ΔA, ΔB) → autoClean / knots / dangling
git merge-tree --write-tree A B (read-only) for the real conflict set
Score the confusion matrix and append the OracleRecord to .warpline/oracle.jsonl

$absorb-flow.description: One ref -> a WarpState of MEANING (stage 3a). Materialize a read-only ref tree (git archive | tar, no worktree), live-parse it, lift+inject TS/TSX code-units as synthetic nodes in the SAME universe, then compute whole-state essences and stamp every object. The lens only reads the tree — the Phase-1 read-only invariant holds.

steps.action: git archive | tar -x materialize the ref into a temp dir (no worktree, lock-free, read-only)
liftCodeUnits(worktree) then injectCodeUnits(index, units) — synthetic code-unit nodes spliced in BEFORE essence computation
computeEssences over the merged .purpose+code universe (code-units take the v1:ts<exact> tag, .purpose stays v0)
buildWarpState stamps each object's contentId and derives the stateId; remove the worktree in a finally

$pick-flow.description: The single-writer WRITE PATH (Phase 2) — seal the working MEANING into this project's OWN durable history. Absorb the working tree, diff against the parent selvage (the source of truth for change), no-op on an empty diff, else seal a #strand, persist the snapshot, append to the #fabric ledger, and advance the selvage atomically. Writes .warpline/ only — git is read for provenance (HEAD sha, user.name) and never mutated.

steps.action: Lift the working tree (or a ref) to a WarpState of MEANING
readSelvage — the parent tip (null at genesis)
diff(parent, current) — empty ⇒ no-op; else summarize born/retired/contract-changed/renamed
putState — durably persist the snapshot under .warpline/states/
Seal the #strand (attribution + reserved confidence + git-HEAD anchor); appendStrand; writeSelvage (atomic publish)

$weave-forecast.description: The pre-merge MEANING forecast (read-only, ephemeral — no ledger write). Reuses the Oracle pipeline up through predict() only; git is consulted just when --vs-git is requested.

steps.action: Resolve merge-base(A, B)

Optionally (--vs-git) run the full #oracle read-only for the meaning-vs-bytes divergence
